additional_requirements: The binge eating and inappropriate compensatory behaviors both occur, on average, at least once a week for 3 months

S045.name: Fear_of_Weight_Gain
S045.description: Intense fear of gaining weight or of becoming fat, even though at a significantly low weight.

subtypes.Fear of Weight Gain: Extreme fear and loathing of gaining weight or becoming fat.
subtypes.Fear of Specific Foods: Fear that eating high-calorie foods will immediately lead to weight gain.
subtypes.Obsession with Weight Gain: Compulsively checking the scale and becoming extremely anxious about even the slightest increase.

S046.name: Body_Image_Weight_Shape_Disturbance
S046.description: Undue influence of body weight or shape on self-evaluation.

subtypes.Distorted Body Image: Perceiving one's body as much fatter than it actually is or perceiving specific parts as excessively large when looking in the mirror.
subtypes.Self-Worth Dependent on Weight: Judging whether one is a good or successful person solely based on weight or body shape.

S047.name: Compensatory_Behavior_NonPurging
S047.description: Recurrent inappropriate compensatory behaviors to prevent weight gain without purging (direct removal of food).

subtypes.Fasting: Intentionally stopping food intake for a certain period to prevent weight gain.
subtypes.Excessive Exercise: Repetitively performing exercise at a level that exceeds physical limits to prevent weight gain.

S048.name: Compensatory_Behavior_Purging
S048.description: Recurrent inappropriate compensatory behaviors involving the expulsion of food or fluids to prevent weight gain.

subtypes.Self-Induced Vomiting: Intentionally inducing vomiting to remove ingested food.
subtypes.Misuse of Medications: Repetitively misusing laxatives, diuretics, or enemas for the purpose of weight control.

S049.name: Eating_Large_Amount
S049.description: Eating, in a discrete period of time, an amount of food that is definitely larger than what most individuals would eat in a similar period of time under similar circumstances.
examples: Eating more than 3-4 times the amount of a typical meal within 2 hours.
Continuously eating large amounts of high-calorie snacks in addition to main meals.
Eating enough to empty a significant portion of the refrigerator or pantry at once.
Eating clearly more food than others during the same period of time.

S050.name: Loss_of_Control
S050.description: A sense of lack of control over eating during the episode (e.g., a feeling that one cannot stop eating or control what or how much one is eating).
examples: A feeling that once I start eating, I cannot stop even if I want to.
Thinking 'I shouldn't eat any more' but mechanically continuing to eat.
A feeling of helplessness that I cannot decide for myself how much to eat.
Eating as if my body is being controlled by someone else.

info.persona: Manuel Guidry is a technically meticulous diesel mechanic with an artist’s sensibility, a cautious yet adventurous financial planner, a health‑conscious yet sleep‑deprived hobbyist, and a quiet enthusiast of blues, local sports, and road‑trip culture, whose lingering worry fuels both his precision and his occasional over‑commitment.
info.professional_persona: Manuel Guidry is a 26‑year‑old diesel powertrain specialist who blends hands‑on mechanical mastery with an artist’s eye, diagnosing heavy‑duty engines, welding, and crafting custom paint‑matching solutions while pursuing ASE Master Diesel certification and positioning himself as an early adopter of electric and hybrid truck technologies; his curiosity drives him to prototype Raspberry Pi monitoring rigs, his meticulous shop organization ensures safety and efficiency, and his preference for small‑team collaborations makes him a go‑to mentor for junior technicians.
info.cultural_background: Manuel grew up in a German-American family in the Cincinnati suburbs, a region known for its strong Midwestern work ethic and community spirit. His heritage is reflected in his appreciation for local traditions such as Oktoberfest, Cincinnati chili, and goetta, as well as in the neighborhood's emphasis on modesty and reliability. The city's vibrant arts scene, encompassing murals, jazz clubs, and regional galleries, has shaped his artistic curiosity. At the same time, the practical values of the Ohio Midwest—punctuality, teamwork, and a respect for hands-on craftsmanship—are woven into his daily life and professional identity.
info.hobbies_and_interests: Outside the shop, Manuel channels his curiosity into photography, capturing industrial settings, vintage trucks, and street art around Cincinnati. He enjoys sketching and watercolor painting of mechanical subjects, often using his art to visualize repair concepts. Restoring classic diesel trucks as a weekend project lets him merge his mechanical skills with his aesthetic sensibility. He is an avid listener of blues and jazz, frequents small-group gallery openings, and attends local Oktoberfest events. Manuel also builds DIY electronics, such as Raspberry Pi vehicle-monitoring rigs, and reads automotive journals to stay ahead of emerging technologies. To manage stress, he hikes the trails of the nearby Little Miami River and cycles through the city's bike lanes, and he unwinds with simulation games like American Truck Simulator.
info.sports_persona: Manuel Guidry is a devoted fan of the Cincinnati Bengals and the Cincinnati Reds, regularly watches games at the stadium with a small group of friends, rides his commuter bike along the city’s bike lanes for cardio, hikes the Little Miami River trail each weekend, and participates in a local adult pickup soccer league that aligns with FC Cincinnati supporters, while occasionally joining a recreational basketball night at the community center.
info.arts_persona: Manuel Guidry immerses himself in the Cincinnati art scene by attending openings at the Contemporary Arts Center, listening to blues legends like B.B. King and jazz greats such as Miles Davis at intimate downtown clubs, and channeling his creative side through watercolor sketches of diesel engines and industrial landscapes inspired by photographers like Edward Burtynsky, often bringing his own artistic flair to vehicle paint‑matching projects.
info.travel_persona: Manuel Guidry prefers meticulously planned road trips in his restored classic diesel truck, having driven the historic Route 66 to the Auto & Truck Museum in Detroit, spent a weekend exploring the craft‑brewery culture of Asheville, North Carolina, and dreaming of a future itinerary that includes Munich’s Oktoberfest and the German automotive museums of Stuttgart, all while balancing his travel budget with the need to fund his shop apprenticeship program.
info.culinary_persona: Manuel Guidry enjoys hearty Midwestern cuisine, regularly cooking Cincinnati chili topped with cheese and onions, savoring goetta for breakfast, perfecting a homemade bratwurst with locally sourced mustard, and experimenting with a smoky pork rib rub he discovered at a local barbecue joint, while his cooking skill sits at an intermediate level, allowing him to confidently grill but still relying on recipes for more complex dishes like beef stroganoff.

info.persona: Daphne Concepcion is a fiercely imaginative textile technician who channels competitive curiosity into sustainable art‑driven business dreams, while they habitually wrestle with anxiety‑fueled overthinking and occasional impulsive splurges on creative supplies.
info.professional_persona: Daphne Concepcion, a seasoned laundry and dry‑cleaning specialist who blends meticulous fabric‑science knowledge with an imaginative, eco‑creative mindset, designs sustainable stain‑removal protocols, up‑cycles garments for local art collaborations, and steers their busy shop with a detail‑oriented yet flexible approach while constantly questioning vendor promises and competing to be the region’s go‑to textile caretaker.
info.cultural_background: Daphne comes from a white American family with deep roots in the Pacific Northwest. Raised in a modest working‑class household in Okanogan County, she grew up surrounded by the region’s forests, farmlands, and tight‑knit community. Her upbringing emphasized self‑reliance, a strong work ethic, and respect for nature. Although she did not complete formal secondary education, she pursued self‑directed learning through community workshops, online tutorials, and mentorship at her workplace. These experiences combine mainstream American cultural values with a personal appreciation for the local environment and a curiosity about broader artistic and scientific ideas.
info.hobbies_and_interests: Her free time blends artistic expression with outdoor exploration and quiet reflection. She enjoys abstract painting and sketching, often using the natural scenery of Okanogan County as inspiration. Reading books on philosophy, science, and contemporary art feeds her intellectual curiosity. Hiking local trails, gardening, and landscape photography provide a calming counterbalance to her work. Daphne also knits, crochets, and experiments with DIY textile dyeing to upcycle old garments. She plays chess to sharpen strategic thinking, attends local art exhibitions, and keeps a reflective journal to process her emotions.
info.sports_persona: Daphne Concepcion hits the Okanogan County trails for weekly hikes, tends a modest vegetable garden, follows the Seattle Seahawks and the Seattle Sounders FC for a dose of regional sports excitement, and they fit in a bi‑weekly yoga session to balance their competitive drive with mindful movement.
info.arts_persona: Daphne Concepcion spends weekends splashing abstract canvases inspired by the Columbia River sky, curates a private collection of works by Yayoi Kusama and Jackson Pollock, frequents the Okanogan County Art Center exhibitions, knits and dyes garments to the rhythm of Björk’s avant‑garde albums, and they keep a reflective journal that often becomes the seed for new mixed‑media projects.
info.travel_persona: Daphne Concepcion prefers self‑planned road trips that weave through the volcanic landscapes of the Pacific Northwest, has already explored Portland’s indie textile districts and the Japanese city of Kyoto for its historic kimono dyeing workshops, dreams of a summer retreat in the Italian countryside’s 'slow‑fashion' villages, and they balance travel budgets by swapping clothing swaps with fellow artisans.
info.culinary_persona: Daphne Concepcion enjoys cooking farm‑to‑table meals like roasted beet and quinoa salad with lavender‑infused vinaigrette, experiments with foraged sage and wild mushrooms in a hearty ramen, whips up a quick sourdough starter when inspiration strikes, and they often get distracted mid‑recipe by a new painting idea, leaving the kitchen a creative mess.

info.persona: Ace Siu balances a curious, community‑focused spirit with a laid‑back, slightly disorganized approach, weaving together literature, food, and cultural exchange while championing harmony in every endeavor, and they remain resilient enough to adapt when plans go awry.
info.professional_persona: An experienced retailer, Ace Siu combines a humanities‑grounded communication style with bilingual fluency and meticulous POS skills to create a harmonious, customer‑focused store environment, and they are pursuing shift‑supervisor certification while dreaming of someday managing a community‑centric café that blends literature, art, and food.
info.cultural_background: Ace is a second‑generation East Asian American whose parents immigrated from Taiwan. Growing up in the Chicago suburbs, he was raised with a blend of traditional values—emphasis on family harmony, respect for elders, and community cohesion—and the multicultural, independent spirit of the Midwest. He celebrates Lunar New Year and Mid‑Autumn Festival with his family, while also participating in community events like the Wheeling Summer Fest. His bilingual upbringing (English and Mandarin) and exposure to diverse cultural settings shape his inclusive worldview and his commitment to fostering harmony both at work and in his community.
info.hobbies_and_interests: In his free time Ace enjoys a mix of solitary and social activities. He reads classic and contemporary literature, watches indie films, practices calligraphy, and experiments with cooking—especially recipes that blend Asian flavors with Midwestern ingredients. He hikes the trails around Lake County, attends local cultural festivals, plays acoustic guitar at family gatherings, participates in a book club, and hosts occasional board‑game nights with friends, balancing his curiosity with a relaxed, flexible approach to leisure.
info.sports_persona: Ace Siu enjoys solo hiking on Lake County’s winding trails, belongs to the Lake County Hiking Association, occasionally joins a weekend pickup basketball game at the community center, roots for the Milwaukee Bucks, and they balance a laid‑back fitness routine with a love for nature.
info.arts_persona: Ace Siu, an avid cultural enthusiast, reads classics like 'The Great Gatsby' and modern works such as 'The Wind-Up Bird Chronicle,' watches indie films by directors like Wong Kar‑wai and Greta Gerwig, practices Chinese calligraphy in quiet evenings, plays acoustic renditions of Bob Dylan and Bon Iver at family gatherings, and they let these artistic pursuits shape both their leisure time and their emerging café concept.
info.travel_persona: Ace Siu, with a flexible, curiosity‑driven travel style, has explored Kyoto’s historic temples, taken a road trip through the Colorado Rockies, frequently visits Chicago’s literary cafés, dreams of a pilgrimage to Hangzhou’s West Lake, and they favor spontaneous itineraries over rigid schedules.
info.culinary_persona: Ace Siu’s culinary experiments blend Asian flavors with Midwestern comfort—think miso‑glazed pork ribs paired with corn polenta, Sichuan‑spiced bratwurst, and kimchi fried rice finished with locally sourced cheddar—and they enjoy whisking, searing, and rolling with confidence, though they sometimes forget to set a timer and over‑sauce dishes.
